cards.name: IndianOil Kotak Credit Card

rules.desc: 24 reward points per Rs150 at IndianOil outlets, 1 RP = Rs0.25 (issuer value chart). 1% fuel surcharge waiver (txns Rs100-5,000, max Rs100 per statement cycle, IndianOil only, not on UPI) is separate and NOT included in rate. Total up to 5% per issuer.

cards.notes: Fuel rate, caps, fee Rs449 and waiver Rs50,000 from Kotak official page; cap_inr = 1,200 RP x Rs0.25. Base 3 RP/Rs150 = 0.5%; UPI also 0.5%. Fuel at non-IndianOil pumps earns only general rate. Forex markup not stated. Fee excludes GST. Application status not confirmed.

cards.name: IndianOil Axis Bank Credit Card

rules.desc: 20 EDGE points per Rs100 at IOCL on txns Rs400-4,000, 1 EDGE point = Rs0.20; up to Rs5,000 fuel spend/month. 1% fuel surcharge waiver capped Rs50 per cycle (not in rate).
5 EDGE points per Rs100 on txns Rs100-5,000, up to Rs5,000 online spend/month at Rs0.20

cards.notes: Official Axis T&C PDF (1 page, June 2025 revision) read: confirms only the reward exclusion list; earn rates come from cardadvisor (page dated 4 Sep 2026). Fee Rs500 + Rs500 joining, excl GST; waiver Rs3.5L (older sources say Rs50,000). Welcome up to 1,250 EDGE points. Other spend 1 pt/Rs100 = 0.2%. Axis menu also lists an 'IndianOil Easy' card, not researched.

cards.name: IndianOil Axis Bank Premium Credit Card

rules.desc: 6 EDGE Miles per Rs150 at IOCL; ~4% assumes Rs1 per Mile when redeemed at IOCL fuel (statement credit only ~Rs0.20/pt). 1% fuel surcharge waiver (conflict: 'unlimited' vs Rs400-4,000 band) not in rate.

cards.notes: NEW APPLICATIONS PAUSED per cardadvisor; existing holders keep it. cap_inr = 600 Miles/month (~Rs15,000 spend). Fee waiver conflict: Rs30,000 (cardadvisor) vs Rs1 lakh (bankbazaar). Groceries 2 Miles/Rs150 up to Rs5,000, other 1 Mile/Rs150 (value unclear, rules omitted). Official Axis page could not be read (navigation only).

cards.name: IDFC FIRST HPCL Power+ Credit Card

rules.desc: 30X reward points per Rs150 at HPCL, 1 RP = Rs0.25 (issuer savings calc shows 5%). NO 1% fuel surcharge waiver. HP Pay app adds 6 Happy Coins per Rs100 (~1.5%, HPCL currency, max 600 coins/month on Rs10,000) not in rate. Cap 2,400 RP/cycle per cardadvisor (not seen on issuer page).
30X per Rs150 on grocery and utility; utility cap Rs2,000/cycle unverified per cardadvisor

cards.notes: 30X/Rs150 and Happy Coins from IDFC official page. Fee Rs499 joining/annual and waiver Rs1.5L from cardadvisor only. Issuer headline 'up to 6.5%' = 5% + 1.5% HP Pay. Base 3X per Rs150 = 0.5%. Zero forex stated on issuer page. Non-HPCL fuel earns nothing (cardadvisor). Conflicting hotel/flight bonus figures omitted.

cards.name: IDFC FIRST HPCL Power Credit Card

rules.desc: 21X reward points per Rs150 at HPCL, 1 RP = Rs0.25 (issuer savings calc: Rs2,100 on Rs60,000 = 3.5%). No fuel surcharge waiver. HP Pay app adds 6 Happy Coins per Rs100 (~1.5%) not in rate. Fuel cap unknown.

cards.notes: Entry variant on same issuer page: joining and annual fee Rs199, annual fee reversed on a spend threshold not captured. 15X on grocery/utility/FASTag, 2X other (RP per Rs150). Caps, forex markup, exclusions not read.

cards.name: HPCL ENERGIE BOBCARD

rules.desc: 24 RP per Rs150 at eligible HPCL outlets (incl. LPG, HP Pay app purchases; not HP Pay wallet load/direct debit), 1 RP = Rs0.25. 1% fuel surcharge waiver on Rs400-5,000, max Rs100 per statement, not in rate. Since 15 Jul 2026 only on HPCL outlets on the BOBCARD eligible MID/TID list. Cap 1,000 RP/statement per cardadvisor.
10 RP per Rs150 on utility bills and departmental stores, shares the same 1,000 RP cap at Rs0.25

cards.notes: Official page: 24 RP/Rs150 (4%) + 1% waiver, fee Rs499 waived at Rs50,000, 1 RP = Rs0.25, waiver cap Rs100/statement. Cap, forex 3.5%, 2 RP/Rs150 other from cardadvisor. Conflict: BOB MITC footnote reportedly says waiver-eligible fuel txns earn no points, which would contradict stacking. Rupay only. Many MCCs (5411 supermarkets, tolls etc.) earn nothing.

cards.name: ICICI HPCL Coral Credit Card

rules.desc: 2.5% cashback at HPCL pumps, capped Rs100/month (issuer). Plus 1% fuel surcharge waiver on txns Rs400-4,000 at HPCL via ICICI POS (cap Rs500/month per cardadvisor, unverified), not in rate. Issuer says up to 3.5% total.

cards.notes: Fee Rs199 joining/annual excl GST, waiver Rs50,000, forex 3.5% from issuer. Other earn 2 RP per Rs100 (Rs0.25 assumed by cardadvisor, redemption up to Rs0.40). Cardadvisor changelog claims fuel stopped earning points Jan 2026 but cashback still listed; cashback treated as active.

cards.name: Standard Chartered Super Value Titanium

rules.desc: 5% cashback at ALL fuel stations, only txns of Rs2,000 or below, max Rs100 per txn, Rs200 per statement cycle, credited to R360 portal. 1% fuel surcharge waiver discontinued 25 Aug 2024.
5% cashback on phone bills (Rs200/cycle) and utility bills (Rs100/cycle) via SC bill pay only, min Rs750 per txn, max Rs100 per txn

cards.notes: Only card found with a flat any-pump fuel rule. Other spend 1 RP per Rs150 (Rs0.25 assumed, cardadvisor). Fee Rs750 + GST, waiver Rs90,000 per cardadvisor; forex 3.5% per issuer FAQ. Application status not confirmed.

cards.name: IndusInd Bank Jio-bp Mobility+ Credit Card

rules.desc: 12 Smiles per Rs100 at Jio-bp (fuel, EV charging, wildbean, convenience store), 1 Smile = Rs0.25 (cardadvisor's estimate; IndusInd publishes no rupee value). 1% fuel surcharge waiver at all Jio-bp stations (no cap stated) not in rate. Cap 1,200 Smiles per statement cycle. Smiles redeem only at Jio-bp outlets.
5 Smiles per Rs100 on dining, supermarket, grocery at Rs0.25

cards.notes: Rates and 1,200-Smile cap from issuer page; fees (nil renewal, Rs499 joining waived on Rs10,000 in 90 days) and 3.5% forex from cardadvisor, forex FAQ on issuer page agrees. Other spend 2 Smiles/Rs100. Milestone conflict: issuer says 4,000 bonus Smiles at Rs2L, another section 2,000+2,000; 200 Smiles/cycle on Rs4,000+ Jio-bp spend. 1% + GST fee on fuel above Rs30,000/cycle per cardadvisor. Launched Dec 2025, RuPay.

cards.name: American Express Platinum Card (Charge)

rules.desc: ShopWise/Rewards Xcelerator 12.5 MR per Rs100 at Rs0.60/pt (third_party, unverified)
3X MR on international spend = 7.5 MR per Rs100 at Rs0.60 (issuer says 3X; base is 1 MR per Rs40)

5 MR per Rs100 at any OMC pump (petrol, diesel, CNG): 1 base + 4 bonus. Bonus capped at 5,000 MR per calendar month (Rs1.25L fuel spend); cap_inr = 6,250 MR x Rs0.60. Rs0.60/MR is an assumed value (redemption range Rs0.25 to Rs0.80); at Rs0.25 the rate is 1.25%. No surcharge waiver; Amex charges a convenience fee at pumps (2021: 1%+GST at IOCL/BPCL, nil at HPCL up to Rs5,000, 2%+GST others) - verify.
Not addressed by source; assumed base 1 MR/Rs40 at Rs0.60 (unconfirmed)

cards.notes: VERIFIED against Amex India Platinum benefits page: 5 MR per Rs100 on fuel (1 base + 4 bonus, effective 1 Jun 2021, bonus max 5,000 MR/calendar month). The old cap conflict (Rs3,000 vs 5,000 pts) is explained: 5,000 pts is the BONUS cap; Rs3,000 = 5,000 x Rs0.60 excludes base points. Official page is a 2021-dated T&C block still live in Oct 2026; no 2026 change found, Mobikwik lists '5X per Rs40' (conflict, unconfirmed). Amex Gold Charge lost fuel earn Jun 2025; Platinum Travel earns none on fuel. Official base rate is 1 MR per Rs40 (was shown as Rs50/100 elsewhere), consistent with base_rate 1.5% at Rs0.60. New applications paused. Fee excl 18% GST. Jewellery and online_shopping rules not re-verified.
